import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database
db_path = '⟨workdir⟩'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Define the SQL query for the inner join
sql_query = """
SELECT *
FROM jira__issue_intelligence_analytics i 
INNER JOIN jira__team_performance_dashboard t 
    ON t.user_display_name = i.assignee_name 
    AND t.project_name = i.project_name 
INNER JOIN jira__project_enhanced p 
    ON p.project_name = i.project_name;
"""

# Execute the query and load results into a DataFrame
result_df = pd.read_sql_query(sql_query, conn)

# Close the connection
conn.close()

# Display the shape of the result and first few rows

print(f"Number of joined rows: {len(result_df)}")
print("\nFirst 5 rows of the joined data:")

```
